title: Seasoned Stave Work for the Awakened
summary: Builds on a basic stave course with qi-driven strikes and a guard that ties into footwork.

title: Treatise on the Two-Handed Slide Grip
summary: A treatise on the sliding two-handed grip and the qi timing that let one stave strike at three ranges.

title: Drill Canon of the Rolling Strike
summary: A canon of rolling strikes where momentum carries one blow into the next with qi easing each transition.

title: A Warrior's Guide to the Counter-Rap
summary: Teaches the counter-rap, a quick return strike to the weapon hand that spoils the opponent's attack.

title: Staff and Leg: The Sweeping Method
summary: Pairs stave strikes with low sweeps at the legs, teaching qi-guided balance-breaking at close range.

title: Handbook of the Staff Against the Blade
summary: Shows how a hardwood stave can meet edged weapons by deflection, distance and timing aided by qi.

title: Primer on the Staff in the Narrow Lane
summary: Teaches staff work in alleys and corridors, where a stave must be thrust and shortened rather than swung wide.

title: The Warrior's Second Staff Canon
summary: A second canon for the practised stave-bearer, linking guards, parries and returns into continuous exchanges.

title: On the Reach and Rhythm of the Stave
summary: Teaches fighters to control distance and beat with the stave, choosing when to strike and when to step.

title: Treatise on the Staff Breaking the Charge
summary: Describes how a braced stave and qi-hardened arms stop a rushing opponent and turn the charge aside.
